text: Various presentations and announcements will be made at the City Council meeting.

July 19, 2023 Speaker Nunziata, during the morning session of the meeting, called upon Mayor Olivia Chow to make a few remarks about the late Beverley Salmon. Mayor Chow spoke about the legacy of the late Dr. Beverley Salmon, former Councillor for the City of North York, and the Metropolitan Toronto City Council. Mayor Chow addressed the family of Beverley Salmon, who were present in the Chamber, and acknowledged her great accomplishment of being the first Black woman to be elected to a Municipal Council in Toronto. Mayor Chow reminded Council of how Beverley was responsible for changing the designation of "Alderman" to "Councillor", making this position inclusive to all. Mayor Chow recounted her time working with Beverley at the Urban Alliance on Race Relations acknowledging how Beverley diligently fought for inclusivity in education.
